title: Tenant-led request flows and cost visibility onboarding playbook
creator: Maya Patel
description: Create a repeatable playbook that enables tenant-oriented intake for console and reporting requests, prioritizes based on business impact and cost-sensitivity, and provides an onboarding flow that surfaces per-tenant cost implications and quick-win dashboards. Focus on high-touch enterprise tenants who request custom usage analytics, cost breakdown exports, or SLA-bound dashboards.
background: We see repeat requests from large tenants asking for tailored cost breakdowns, custom exports, and workspace-level dashboards. Current intake is ad hoc: requests land in tickets, but engineers and solutions see insufficient signals to prioritize. That creates long lead times and escalations to Sales/CS. We need a standardized, tenant-facing intake flow and an internal triage rubric that ties request signals to delivery lanes (self-serve vs. concierge vs. dedicated engineering).
proposal: Deliver a two-part playbook: (1) Tenant-facing intake form and onboarding checklist that captures required signals (use case, SLA needs, sample queries, expected rows/volume, cost sensitivity, security constraints). (2) Internal prioritization matrix that maps signals to delivery lanes, estimated effort buckets, recommended quick-win dashboard templates, and required approvals (legal/engineering/security). Include example email templates, canned Confluence templates, and a lightweight decision table for PM/SE handoffs.
acceptance_criteria: Tenant intake form mock and final copy in Confluence + link embedded in CS onboarding playbook
Prioritization matrix with at least 6 signals (volume, SLA, coverage, cost sensitivity, security, analytical complexity) and mapping to 3 delivery lanes
Two starter dashboard templates (cost breakdown, usage trend) with sample dataset and deployable Looker/Metabase JSON or sample CSV
Handoff checklist for Engineering with required artifacts (sample export query, expected cadence, retention needs)
A rollout plan for CS to use playbook in next 4 enterprise onboarding calls and a feedback mechanism
decision: Adopt a tenant-first intake with a conservative routing policy: default to self-serve guidance where possible, concierge lane for high revenue/contract tenants, and engineering engagement for requests marked high complexity or high security. Engineering will evaluate template exports for feasibility before scheduling dedicated work.
